title: Ray Hernandez pulled out of his car in a Miami traffic jam

tellings.quote: and then two days later he's in this Miami. He's in a traffic jam completely stalled.

plain: A man named Rey Hernandez is said to have been pulled out of his car while stuck in a completely stalled traffic jam in Miami, two days after some earlier event in his story. A UFO researcher named Grant Cameron tells it on the show as something told to him, and he brings Edgar Mitchell into the account as well; what pulled Hernandez out, the telling leaves vague, but it is offered as a strange contact experience in the middle of ordinary life.
